title: Missing session grant
note: Missing grant gets 401/403, the body does not reveal the session id and no turn is answered; DELETE without a grant gets 401

title: Tampered session grant
note: Grant is an opaque random token looked up by SHA-256 hash, so a forged or malformed grant is rejected; no test flips one byte of a valid grant

title: Expired grant
note: Backend returns 401 session_expired; no test checks that the widget then offers a new anonymous session

title: Cross-session session_id

title: Turn GET/SSE with other session token

title: DELETE other session

title: Repeat DELETE own session
